## zarf dev upgrade

Converts and outputs the existing zarf package config to the given API version. Defaults to latest API version.

```
zarf dev upgrade [ PATH ] [flags]
```

### Examples

```
zarf dev upgrade . > zarf-v1beta1.yaml
```

### Options

```
  -h, --help        help for upgrade
      --to string   Specify the API version to upgrade the package definition to. (default "zarf.dev/v1beta1")
```
